Authentic Italian Experience in Hanoi
Dec 2024 • Family
We had a wonderful dining experience
On this Italian restaurant in Hanoi, which felt as close to the true Italian vibe as possible. The ambiance was warm and welcoming, and the food was exceptional.

We ordered three different dishes, and each one was better than the last. The flavors were authentic, the presentation was beautiful, and everything was cooked with great care and attention to details. 
If you’re craving real Italian food while in Hanoi, this is the place to go! Highly recommended.

PalomaSDH
3 contributions

Perfect for any occasion
Oct 2024 • Couples
My boyfriend and I usually go there almost every Sunday for lunch. The pepperoni pizza and four-cheese pizza are our favorites! The truffle pasta is incredible too – it’s prepared right in a whole wheel of cheese, with a generous amount of fresh truffle. Truly delicious!

The service is friendly and professional, always attentive to our requests, and the dishes come out quickly. The restaurant itself is clean, tidy, and has a cozy ambiance, making it great for a date night as well.

They often treat us to homemade nut cookies at the end of the meal, which is a lovely touch. The prices are very reasonable for the quality. I also recommend the salmon appetizer and the penne arrabbiata!

How difficult can it be?
Oct 2024 • Friends
Dining with friends, who have been regulars for the last 12 months. But was warned that although food is usually good, the service is not always up to scratch. 
Ordered different starters, then four steaks with four portions of french fries. To ensure the order was understood, showed the “four” with my fingers. Emphasised that we want the fries to be served with the steaks as this has been missed in the past.
Starters ok. Steaks are served. We reminded the waitress about our fries. Waited and waited. Reminded again. Then the
hostess came to ask if everything was ok. Obviously not. Where are our fries? Then the hostess and the waitress had a discussion whether or not we had ordered fries, at our table!!! After further wait, with the steaks now
cold, two (!) portions of fries arrived. 
How difficult can it be to take an order for
four portions of fries and serve with the main course?!? 
After declining offers of limoncello or
alcoholic drink (do not drink alcohol), 
we got a small discount on the bill. But we still had to pay for the late two portions fries! 
We are not going back.

Singapore, Singapore31431 contributions

Had a great dining experience here!
Jun 2024 • Couples
This was one of the best dining experience that we had in Hanoi during our short stay. It was located very close to where we were staying, the Oakwood residence. We were attracted by the very nice decoration at the courtyard to the restaurant. It was a great decision as the service staff was very friendly and hospitable during our dinner. We ordered the cheese barrel carbonara with truffle, salad, premium rib eye steak (medium rare) and tiramisu. All the dishes were well executed and tasted great, especially the rib eye. It was cooked to our instruction. There were very generous with the truffle on our pasta as well. It was a joy to watch the service staff putting the final touches to our carbonara. Prices were reasonable considering the quality ingredients that they used for their dishes.

YOU BRING A KISS TO FLORENCE: I am an Italian and a Florentine and discovering that there is a piece of my city in Hanoi gave me an extreme pleasure... I had the opportunity to taste the excellent steak alla Fiorentina and a good plate of spaghetti ... as well as a good glass of wine ... I immediately felt in Tuscany in my Florence ... the service and kindness of the waitress was impeccable in addition to the competence of the general manager who I had the opportunity to meet and who carefully manages the staff and the kitchen. If you want to feel like you are in Italy and taste Tuscan cuisine you cannot miss a piece of Florence in Hanoi… extremely recommended.
